title: Companion custom native question answer
description: Use a fresh NATIVE_COMPANION_PROOF_STATE and the private gateway, token file and simulator environment. A real Claude question has suggested options; Companion sends custom text and the runner repeats the received answer.

setup.cmd: NATIVE_COMPANION_RUNNER=claude NATIVE_COMPANION_MODEL=sonnet yarn exec tsx scripts/agentic/native-conversation-proof.mts setup-question
setup.intent: Create a disposable real Claude question with suggested options.

open.intent: Open the exact session through the actual app route.

wait-answer.intent: Custom input remains available when the question has options.

type-answer.intent: Enter an answer outside the runner suggestions.

capture-answer.intent: Record suggestions and the custom answer before submission.

send-answer.intent: Submit custom text through the actual question control.

verify-answer.intent: Prove request resolution and the runner receiving the exact custom answer.

cleanup.intent: Close only the disposable proof session.

dismiss-keyboard.intent: Finish the custom answer using the native Return key and reveal the submit control.
